concept.title: Preferential Issue
concept.shortdesc: A company may issue shares to a strategic investor or collaborator at a pre-negotiated price.

conbody.p: A company may issue shares to a strategic investor or collaborator at a pre-negotiated price. The pricing for such an issue is determined under various SEBI guidelines. A preferential issue dilutes (reduces) the proportionate rights of existing shareholders and thus requires approval of existing shareholders.
